question: Which change of release 26.3 explains the fall in conversion?
title: What explains the fall
summary: The payments review links the fall to 3-D Secure challenges, which rose from 8% to 31% of card payments. The frontend guild says the slower checkout page after the CDN switch explains most of it. Neither source measures the other change's effect.
gist: Contested: 3-D Secure challenges or the slower page after the CDN switch.
stakes: which change to roll back first
done_when: sources attribute the fall to a change with data on that change's effect
